onset.Description: Seizure start: release clock time minus EDF header start clock time (modulo 24 h).

duration.Description: Seizure end minus start from the release; n/a where the release value is inconsistent (see note). Raw annotations follow the release text only; the SzCORE re-annotation in derivatives/szcore gives its own reading where this column is n/a (PN00 run-03: 60 s).

Levels.seizure: Epileptic seizure annotated by the clinicians

seizure_label.Description: Free-text qualifier after "Seizure n" in the release (e.g. "in sleep", "seizure B1").

electrodes_at_onset.Description: Electrodes involved at seizure start, where the release states them.

release_start_time.Description: Seizure start time exactly as written in the release (hh.mm.ss).

release_end_time.Description: Seizure end time exactly as written in the release (hh.mm.ss).

note.Description: Curation notes: release typos and how they were handled. Nothing was silently corrected.
